project: BrainBoard V2 - Autonomous Project & Milestone Management with AI MCP

testSuites.description: Comprehensive individual feature verification covering REST CRUD for Projects, Stages, UpdateLogs, Members, Tasks (under Stages), Subtasks, real MCP SSE transport and tool execution, and Docker configurations.

domains.description: Project model operations including title, description, businessLogic, githubRepo, and settings JSON.

tests.name: REST POST /api/projects - Project Creation with Metadata and Settings
tests.description: Verify POST /api/projects creates a project with title, description, businessLogic, githubRepo, settings JSON, and default status PLANNING.

tests.name: REST GET /api/projects and GET /api/projects/:id - Listing and Full Hierarchy
tests.description: Verify GET /api/projects lists projects and GET /api/projects/:id returns full nested relations (stages, tasks, subtasks, updateLogs, members).

tests.name: REST PATCH /api/projects/:id - Status Transition and Field Updates
tests.description: Verify PATCH /api/projects/:id updates status to ACTIVE or COMPLETED, and updates githubRepo and settings.

tests.name: REST PATCH /api/projects/:id/business-logic - Dedicated Business Logic Route
tests.description: Verify PATCH /api/projects/:id/business-logic updates markdown business logic specifications.

tests.name: REST PATCH /api/projects/:id/settings - Dedicated Settings Route
tests.description: Verify PATCH /api/projects/:id/settings updates githubRepo and settings JSON dynamically.

tests.name: REST POST /api/projects/:projectId/stages - Stage Creation with Auto-Order
tests.description: Verify POST /api/projects/:projectId/stages creates a stage with title, auto-calculated incrementing order, and PLANNING status.

tests.name: REST GET /api/projects/:projectId/stages & PATCH /api/stages/:id - Listing and Status Update
tests.description: Verify stages can be listed by project and updated to IN_PROGRESS or COMPLETED.

domains.description: UpdateLog (Diário de Bordo) operations with rich Markdown.

tests.name: REST POST /api/projects/:projectId/update-logs - Rich Markdown Log Creation
tests.description: Verify POST /api/projects/:projectId/update-logs creates a log with title, markdown content, and author.

tests.name: REST GET /api/projects/:projectId/update-logs & GET /api/update-logs/:id - Listing
tests.description: Verify update logs are listed in descending chronological order.

domains.description: Project team members with name, role, and optional email.

tests.name: REST POST /api/projects/:projectId/members - Member Creation with Email and Role
tests.description: Verify POST /api/projects/:projectId/members creates a member record with name, email, and role.

tests.name: REST GET /api/projects/:projectId/members & PATCH /api/members/:id - Listing and Role Update
tests.description: Verify team members can be listed and updated.

tests.name: REST POST /api/stages/:stageId/tasks - Task Creation Scoped to Stage
tests.description: Verify task creation requires stageId, defaults to TODO status, and eliminates legacy Category enum.

tests.name: REST GET /api/stages/:stageId/tasks & PATCH /api/tasks/:id - Progress Workflow
tests.description: Verify tasks are filtered by stageId and progress through TODO -> IN_PROGRESS -> DONE.

domains.description: Subtask checklist items belonging to tasks.

tests.name: REST POST /api/tasks/:id/subtasks - Subtask Creation
tests.description: Verify subtask is created under parent taskId with default isDone false.

tests.name: REST PATCH /api/subtasks/:id - Subtask Toggle
tests.description: Verify subtask isDone flag can be toggled.

domains.description: Real Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server-Sent Events (SSE) Transport & Tool Execution.

tests.name: MCP Real SSE Connection & Session Handshake
tests.description: Connects to GET /mcp/sse, receives endpoint event, parses sessionId and client POST message path.

tests.name: MCP tools/list Schema Discovery
tests.description: Invokes tools/list over JSON-RPC; asserts discovery of read_project_context, update_business_logic, update_project_settings, log_project_update, create_task, move_task, add_subtask, toggle_subtask.

tests.name: MCP update_business_logic Tool Invocation
tests.description: Calls update_business_logic via MCP SSE client and asserts businessLogic markdown is updated in database.

tests.name: MCP log_project_update Tool Invocation
tests.description: Calls log_project_update via MCP SSE client with markdown content and asserts new UpdateLog record is created.

tests.name: MCP read_project_context Tool Invocation
tests.description: Calls read_project_context via MCP SSE client and asserts complete project graph is returned (stages, tasks, subtasks, logs, members, settings).

tests.name: MCP update_project_settings Tool Invocation
tests.description: Calls update_project_settings via MCP SSE client to update githubRepo and dynamic settings JSON.

tests.name: MCP create_task and move_task with stageId
tests.description: Calls create_task specifying stageId and moves it to DONE using move_task.

tests.name: Backend Dockerfile Directives and Prisma Generate
tests.description: Verify backend/Dockerfile specifies node:20-alpine, prisma generate, EXPOSE 3000.

tests.name: Frontend Dockerfile Multi-Stage Build & Nginx Runtime
tests.description: Verify frontend/Dockerfile uses multi-stage build and nginx:alpine runtime.

tests.name: Root docker-compose.yml Multi-Service Orchestration
tests.description: Verify docker-compose.yml orchestrates backend and frontend with DATABASE_URL.

tests.name: Nginx Reverse Proxy & SPA Fallback Configuration
tests.description: Verify frontend/nginx.conf specifies proxy_pass for /api/ and SPA fallback.

testSuites.description: Rigorous input validation, error handling, edge cases, payload stress, and security escaping fidelity.

tests.name: Empty and Whitespace-Only Titles Rejected with 400 Across Entities
tests.description: Asserts 400 Bad Request when creating Project, Stage, Task, or Subtask with empty or whitespace-only title.

tests.name: Large Text Payload Stress (Unbounded Text Preservation)
tests.description: Stores and retrieves 5,000+ character markdown documents in businessLogic and UpdateLog without truncation.

tests.name: Special Characters, UTF-8 Emojis, XSS, and SQL Injection Escaping Fidelity
tests.description: Stores complex malicious payloads with quotes, scripts, emojis, and SQL syntax, asserting exact character fidelity and parameterized query protection.

tests.name: Non-Existent UUID Handling Returns 404
tests.description: Asserts 404 Not Found for non-existent UUIDs across Project, Stage, UpdateLog, Member, Task, and Subtask routes.

tests.name: Invalid Enum Values Rejected with 400 Bad Request
tests.description: Asserts 400 Bad Request when passing invalid values for ProjectStatus, StageStatus, or Status enums.

tests.name: Project Settings JSON Validation & Null Handling
tests.description: Accepts complex nested JSON settings objects, handles null and empty settings gracefully without schema corruption.

tests.name: Member Validation and Optional Email Support
tests.description: Rejects missing required fields (name, role) with 400 Bad Request and validates member creation with email.

testSuites.description: Verification of relational integrity, cascade deletions across all 3 tiers of the hierarchy, and dual REST <-> MCP synchronization.

tests.name: Full Hierarchy Cascade: Project Deletion Purges All Child Entities
tests.description: Creates Project -> Stages -> Tasks -> Subtasks -> UpdateLogs -> Members. Deletes Project; verifies ALL child entities return 404.

tests.name: Stage Cascade: Stage Deletion Purges Tasks and Subtasks
tests.description: Deletes a Stage; verifies all child Tasks and Subtasks return 404, while parent Project and sibling Stages remain intact.

tests.name: Task Cascade: Task Deletion Purges Subtasks
tests.description: Deletes a Task; verifies child Subtasks return 404 while parent Stage and sibling Tasks remain intact.

tests.name: Dual Interface Synchronization (REST ↔ MCP Shared State)
tests.description: REST creates Project & Stage -> MCP updates businessLogic -> REST reads back updated state -> REST adds Task -> MCP reads context -> MCP adds Task -> REST verifies.

tests.name: Multi-Stage Task Scoping and Isolation
tests.description: Tasks created in Stage A are strictly isolated from Stage B. Deleting Stage A leaves Stage B and its tasks completely unaffected.

testSuites.description: Autonomous AI Agent Project Onboarding & Software Development Lifecycle.

tests.name: Autonomous AI Project Onboarding & SDLC Lifecycle Scenario
tests.description: Complete real-world execution: 1. REST creates Project with githubRepo and settings; 2. REST defines 3 Stages; 3. REST adds team members; 4. MCP updates business logic; 5. MCP logs kickoff update; 6. MCP creates tasks under Stage 1; 7. Subtasks added; 8. Tasks completed; 9. Stage marked COMPLETED; 10. MCP reads full context; 11. Clean cascade teardown.

tests.name: Rapid Agile Milestone Delivery Scenario
tests.description: Simulates rapid sprint progression: creates feature milestone, creates tasks, transitions statuses, records progress logs, and verifies delivery state.

tests.name: Audit Trail & Project Governance Scenario
tests.description: Simulates multiple AI and human contributors adding update logs, modifying technical settings, and verifying complete audit trail retrieval.
